local_blastp_recheck: blastp -query 00_audit/reference.faa -subject 01_merge/merged.faa -evalue 1e-20 -max_hsps 1 -max_target_seqs 5000 -num_threads 4 -outfmt '7 qseqid sseqid pident qcovs ppos length qlen slen qstart qend evalue bitscore'
mip: python3 TxtC_pipeline_starter/scripts/03_mip.py --msa align/focus/txtc_focus.fasta --weights align/focus/weights.txt --position-map align/focus/position_map.csv --output results/mip/mip_allpairs.csv
dca_1x: plmc -f TXT_C_REF_Q8VS75 -g -w align/focus/weights.txt -lh 0.01 -le 75.81 -m 100 -n 4 -c results/dca/plmc_couplings.txt -o results/dca/plmc.params align/focus/txtc_focus.fasta
compare: python3 TxtC_pipeline_starter/scripts/04_compare.py --mip results/mip/mip_allpairs.csv --plmc results/dca/plmc_couplings.txt --position-map align/focus/position_map.csv --site-qc align/focus/site_qc.csv --outdir results/compare --min-separation 6
structure: python3 TxtC_pipeline_starter/scripts/05_structure_contacts.py --reference raw/reference/TxtC_Q8VS75.fasta --position-map align/focus/position_map.csv --pairs results/compare/dca_ranked.csv --structure raw/structure/6F0B.cif --chain A --out-prefix results/structure/6F0B_DCA (repeat for 6F0C and for mip_ranked.csv)
